read.thesis: Nextracker raised FY25 profit target by $20M to $645M on record $4.5B backlog, but Q2 margin was flattered by one-offs (~300bp) and management expects those not to repeat; supply-side signals are mostly neutral.

triggers.label: FY25 profit target raised $20M to $645M
triggers.quote: we are raising our profit target for the full fiscal year by $20 million at the midpoint to $645 million

triggers.label: Backlog record over $4.5B
triggers.quote: Our backlog increased significantly quarter-over-quarter to a new record of over $4.5 billion

triggers.label: Q2 margin uplift not to repeat
triggers.quote: that will probably not repeat in Q3 and Q4. It might, but our plan is it will be more like 1% to 2%

triggers.label: FY26 double-digit growth not restated
triggers.quote: We'll provide a lot more color on the FY '26 revenue plan in subsequent earnings calls

guidance.quote: we are raising our profit target for the full fiscal year by $20 million at the midpoint to $645 million
we remain focused on executing our plan to achieve double-digit revenue growth for the full year
structurally, it should be in the high 20s, maybe be low 30s

red_flags.label: Q2 margin flattered by one-offs
red_flags.quote: that will probably not repeat in Q3 and Q4

red_flags.label: FY26 growth language softened
red_flags.quote: We'll provide a lot more color on the FY '26 revenue plan in subsequent earnings calls

evasions.quote: We'll provide a lot more color on the FY '26 revenue plan in subsequent earnings calls
it's too really right now to say what that's going to look like next year

evasions.topic: 100% US tracker share of next-year business
evasions.quote: We're going to have to wait and see on that and speak to it later
